text: For behold, the Lord YHWH of hosts is turning away from Jerusalem and from Judah the staff and support—the whole staff of bread, and the whole staff of water—
the mighty one and the man of war, the judge and the prophet, and the diviner and the elder,
the captain of fifty, and the lifted up of faces, and the counselor, and the cunning magician, and the discerning charmer.
“And I will give youths as their princes, and infants will rule over them.”
And the people will be oppressed, each man by a man and each man by his neighbor; the child will rage against the elder, and the one despised against the honored.
For a man will take hold on his brother in the house of his father: “A cloak [is] unto you—the chief you will be for us, and this heap of ruins [is] under your hand;”
he will lift up in that day to say, “I will not be one binding [wounds], and in my house there is no bread and no garment; you⁺ shall not set me [as] chief of the people.”
For Jerusalem has stumbled, and Judah has fallen, because their tongue and their deeds [are] against YHWH, defying the eyes of His glory.
The look of their faces answers against them, and their sin like Sodom they declare—they do not hide [it]! Woe to their soul, for they have brought evil upon themselves.
Say to the righteous that [it is] good, for the fruit of their deeds they will eat.
Woe to the wicked—evil; for the recompense of his hands will be done to him!
My people—their oppressors [are] foolish children, and women rule over them. O My people, those who guide you lead [you] astray, and the way of your paths they have swallowed up.
YHWH Is taking [His] stand to contend, and is standing to judge the peoples.
YHWH will enter into judgment with the elders of His people and His princes: “And you⁺—you⁺ have consumed the vineyard; the plunder of the poor [is] in your⁺ houses.
Why do you crush My people, and grind the faces of the poor?” A declaration of the Lord YHWH of hosts.
And says YHWH: “Because that the daughters of Zion are haughty, and they walk with outstretched neck and wanton eyes, walking and skipping [as] they go, and with their feet jingling,
and the Lord will bring scabs [to] the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and YHWH will make their foreheads bare.
That in the day the Lord will turn away the beauty of the anklets and the headbands, and the crescents,
the pendants, and the bracelets, and the veils,
the headdresses, and the armlets, and the sashes, and the boxes of perfume, and the charms,
the signet rings, and nose rings,
the [festive] robes, and the tunics, and the cloaks, and the purses,
and the mirrors, and the linen [garments], and the turbans, and the veils.

And it will come to pass, instead of of spice, [that] there will be rottenness; and instead of a belt, a rope; and instead of worked hair, baldness; and instead of a fine robe, a girding of sackcloth; and shame instead of beauty.
Your men will fall by the sword, and your mighty ones in battle;
and her gates will lament and mourn and she will be left empty—on the ground she will sit.
